This success helped the studio secure a distribution partnership with Walt Disney Studios for the U.S. release of “Princess Mononoke” and later “Spirited Away.” The partnership, along with the film’s strong home‑video sales and merchandise, cemented Ghibli’s brand in the West and paved the way for the worldwide release of many of its subsequent titles.
